title.tr: Çimde dikdörtgen turuncu deck, sağda dolap
title.en: Rectangular orange deck on the lawn with a cabinet at the right

alt.tr: Çimen üzerinde dikdörtgen turuncu deck ve sağda yeşil çit önünde duran ahşap dolap
alt.en: Rectangular orange deck on the lawn with a timber cabinet standing in front of the green hedge on the right

caption.en: The deck sits in the lawn with a straight edge and the cabinet leans into the corner of the hedge. A cypress hedge stretches behind.
